description: Source file defining the em_cmd_t class with methods for command validation, event data handling, copying, string conversion, initialization, cloning, and mapping between command types and bus event types. It also includes functions for dumping bus events and managing command objects related to Wi-Fi mesh configuration and control.

classes.name: em_cmd_t
classes.description: Class representing a command in the Wi-Fi mesh system, with methods for validation, copying events, string conversion, cloning, and mapping command types.

methods.name: get_event_data_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the event data based on event type.

methods.name: set_event_data_length
methods.description: Sets the length of the event data based on event type.

methods.name: copy_bus_event
methods.description: Copies a bus event into the command's event structure.

methods.name: copy_frame_event
methods.description: Copies a frame event into the command's event structure.

methods.name: status_to_string
methods.description: Converts command output status to a string representation.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the command, destroying queues and deinitializing data model.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the command with a data model.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the command object.

methods.name: clone_for_next
methods.description: Creates a clone for the next operation in a sequence.

methods.name: override_op
methods.description: Overrides the operation at a specified index with a new descriptor.

methods.name: get_bus_event_type_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of bus event type.

methods.name: get_orch_op_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of orchestration operation type.

methods.name: get_cmd_type_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of command type.

methods.name: bus_2_cmd_type
methods.description: Maps bus event type to command type.

methods.name: cmd_2_bus_event_type
methods.description: Maps command type to bus event type.

methods.name: dump_bus_event
methods.description: Prints details of a bus event for debugging.
